% One 100 x 50 bp page with /UserUnit 10, i.e. a page that is 10 times larger
% than its boxes say (1000 x 500 pt) for renderers that honor UserUnit.
% Built with plain pdfTeX by ../regenerate.sh (reproducible: no dates / IDs).
\pdfinfoomitdate=1
\pdftrailerid{}
\pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfobjcompresslevel=2
\nopagenumbers
\parindent=0pt
\hoffset=-1in \voffset=-1in
\pdfpagewidth=100bp \pdfpageheight=50bp
\hsize=100bp \vsize=50bp
\pdfpageattr{/UserUnit 10}
\vbox to 50bp{\vss\hbox to 100bp{\hss\vrule width 10bp height 10bp\hss}\vss}
\bye
